source.title: SciToolAgent-Evo: An Ontology-Aware Self-Evolving Agent for Open-World Scientific Tool Acquisition
source.benchmark_scope: 900 scientific tool-use tasks across biology, chemistry and materials science, four difficulty levels

observations: The tool ontology explicitly represents invocation constraints and scientific applicability, including applicable objects and scientific scenarios.
Each experience record includes an applicable scientific situation s_e in addition to domain, tool-selection guidance and retrieval embedding.
At inference, the agent retrieves memory and then formulates active tool requests as requirement descriptions before ontology-guided retrieval/reranking and gate control.

Fine-grained ablation reports overall 67.22 for the full pipeline, 56.20 without Active Request (-11.02), and 58.73 when Active Request is replaced by Retrieval Rewriting (-8.49). The paper interprets this as requirement-conditioned retrieval better capturing task-specific tool needs than raw-query matching. Level-3 drops 17.28 points without Active Request and Level-4 drops 13.32 points.
Component ablation reports 52.35 without Knowledge Accumulation (-14.87), 51.53 without Tool Migration (-15.69), 63.99 without Skill (-3.23), and 65.65 without Experience (-1.57), versus 67.22 full.

protocol_inference.name: RETRIEVAL_TO_ACTION_REQUIREMENT_BINDING
protocol_inference.rule: Semantic retrieval is candidate selection rather than execution authority. Before selecting or acquiring a scientific tool, bind the action decision to an explicit representation of the current requirement and the candidate's scientific applicability/constraints, rather than relying only on raw-query similarity.
protocol_inference.evidence_strength: direct matched component ablation for scientific tool routing
protocol_inference.scope_boundary: The ablation isolates Active Request within an ontology-aware scientific tool-use pipeline, not a receiver-side negative-memory applicability/revalidation gate. It therefore supports requirement-conditioned action routing but does not establish causal benefit for failure-memory PRUNE/FORBID validation or physical-lab authorization.

next_probe: Locate a public implementation/revision for SciToolAgent-Evo and inspect whether stored experience applicability s_e is enforced during retrieval/reranking or merely available to the model; then seek an ablation that holds stored memory and retrieval fixed while toggling receiver-side applicability validation.
